_README: Fill this in and send it back. Every field here changes the code, so
programming waits on it. Leave a value as null if it is genuinely still
open — null is information; a guess is not.
Fields beginning with _ are notes to you and are ignored by the build.
title: Trail

deathModel._pool: One health value. Simpler, reads faster, no names to get attached to.
deathModel._party: Oregon Trail's model: individuals tracked separately, run ends with the last of them. More attachment, more UI, more text to write.
deathModel._partySize: Only if 'party'. 3-5 is the workable range at 320x180.

runShape._endless: Difficulty rises forever. Score is distance. No win state.
runShape._destination: A place you can actually reach. Needs a total distance and an ending.
runShape._totalDistance: Only if 'destination'. In the same units biomes use.
runShape._difficultyCurve: linear | stepped | accelerating — how fast it turns against you.

resources._note: List only the ones that really exist. Four is plenty; six needs a tutorial and there is nowhere to put one.

persistence._note: Single life implies no saves, but a best-distance counter is a different thing from a save. Anything kept stays in the browser; nothing about a player leaves their device.

palette._note: 16 or fewer. A build check will fail any asset using a colour outside this list, so it holds after everyone stops paying attention.
palette._hex: e.g. ["#140c1c", "#442434", ...] — include a true black and a near-white.
palette._uiColour: One hex from the list, reserved for UI and never used in art, so text stays legible over a busy backdrop.

font._uppercaseOnly: true is fine and period-appropriate; lowercase then maps to the same glyphs.

sheets._note: Frame count per ROW. This is the only metadata the code needs — no atlas file.

biomes._note: Just the ids here; the full definitions go in content/biomes.json. One backdrop and one or more parallax layers per biome.

sound._note: Optional. Never autoplays — browsers block it and a 404 that makes noise unprompted is hostile.

_openQuestions: Anything you want decided jointly rather than handed over — put it here and it gets answered before build, not during.
